title: Mishti Doi
description: Bengal's sweet set yogurt, made with caramelised sugar and slow-set overnight into a creamy, pale-brown dessert.

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.notes: 30 g for the caramel and the rest for the milk

ingredients.name: Curd
ingredients.notes: fresh and mildly sour, as starter

steps: Boil the milk on medium heat, stirring often, until reduced by about a third, about 30 minutes.
In a small pan melt 30 g of the sugar with the water until it becomes a golden-brown caramel.
Carefully pour the caramel into the hot milk and stir until it dissolves, then add the remaining sugar.
Cool the milk until just lukewarm, about 40 degrees, and whisk in the curd.
Pour into a clay pot or heatproof bowl, cover and keep in a warm place for 8 to 10 hours until set.
